name: 羊羔绒宽松不臃肿针织毛衣款
description: 羊羔绒细腻亲肤、宽松慵懒不挑人、保暖又透气的秋冬针织毛衣

styleLock.backgroundSystem: clean cream page background #FDF8F2 with blush pink #FBEDE4 and warm beige #EDE0D4 section panels; flat, no gradients
styleLock.lightingSystem: soft natural window light from the side for lifestyle shots, bright even high-key studio light for infographic shots, soft shadows, no harsh contrast
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte warm beige paper-like panels #EDE0D4; sage green fabric sofa and white chair in lifestyle scenes
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif; deep charcoal #2D2D2D headlines with a letter-spaced uppercase English subtitle line; short two-to-four-character labels only
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line circular icons in caramel brown #A97950 with two-character labels; single thin-line garment outline icon for care tips
styleLock.presentationRules: garment shown on a generic young female model at eye level with slight 3/4 angle in lifestyle shots; straight-on flat-lay and flat graphic for infographic screens; stable scale, generous cream margins
noDrift: no serif or handwritten decorative type
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm minimalist knitwear ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of cream off-white background #FDF8F2, blush pink section panel #FBEDE4, warm beige surface #EDE0D4, and caramel brown accent #A97950 with deep charcoal text #2D2D2D; warm tone; modern geometric sans-serif headlines with a letter-spaced uppercase English subtitle line; clean flat beige infographic panels with rounded rectangular labels and thin-line circular icons in caramel brown #A97950; soft natural window light for lifestyle shots and bright even studio light for infographic shots; stable product scale and placement; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 源为 800×1200 详情页长图切片 14 片（相邻重叠 60px），逐片拼合分析。主产品判定以画面为准：女模特上身宽松圆领长款麻花针织毛衣（panel-01/04 实拍、panel-13 洗护提示为 V 领毛衣线描图标、尺码表列为胸围/腰围/肩宽/衣长等针织量法），故归 女装/上衣，不跟随源文案中『棉衣外套/棉服男』的矛盾描述，也不因源文件夹名预判。已剥离：英文装饰标语与手写体、2021/港风等时效词、巨大销量数字（横幅改为宽字距英文短语不写数字）、会员二维码贴纸、模特面部身份；panel-06 变体网格与 panel-10 三处细节图在源中未加载影像，按其文字标注（女士深灰/男士褐色；立领/贴标/侧边口舌）重建为通用版式。颜色/尺码规格（蓝黑棕深灰、S-XXXL）未写入模版，全部以文案槽与生成时填值重建。
